title: Grateful Dead Live at Civic Center on 1973-03-28
lineage: Cassette Master -> Apogee MiniMe -> Samplitude Professional 8.01 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: A stellar 1973 show – killer first set, monster Dark Star > Eyes > Playing stretch – captured on a vivid audience tape that still sounds clear despite the crowd.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this performance, calling the first set “killer” and highlighting the 32‑minute Dark Star/Eyes/Playing sequence as a show‑stopper. The audience recording is praised for its surprisingly clean capture of the band’s tight‑and‑trippy playing, even though one reviewer noted the heavy Northeastern clapping in the background.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both musical performance and recording quality across multiple 5‑star reviews, with only one dissenting comment about crowd noise.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and vivid capture of the band despite noticeable audience clapping; no major dropouts or distortion reported.

poor_songs: "Downward jam" between China Cat Sunflower and Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set rolls on strong with tight, energetic renditions; second set stays competent, anchored by a long Dark Star that builds into an intense Eyes → Playing finale.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar shines – perfect tone on Looks Like Rain and wild Crybaby wah‑wah work throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Lesh delivers atom‑splitting bass, especially during the Dark Star/Eyes passages.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith uses a volume pedal for piano, adding quirky textures; keyboards contribute to the trippy atmosphere.
